CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price

----
